verdict.rationale: A community user praises being able to track how many users a particular bug affects. First-party docs say grouping is meant to show which issues have the biggest impact on users, and stability measures the proportion of error-free sessions, but only at the project level. Per-issue session counts and documented ranking or prioritization by affected users are not shown. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of per-issue user counts, per-issue affected-session counts, sorting or prioritizing the inbox by users or sessions affected, and recent hands-on corroboration.
